[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60594148]The two gentlemen sat down before the consul, before sliding the terms of the declaration before him.

Our requests are simple, strategic, and lasting in their entirety unto perpetuity, began Alfred.

Yes the terms are as noted in our recognition, 

1. A State of Peace shall exist between Thýven and Flousech
2. Trade shall immediately be re-established with the details of such being convened at a formal meeting between representatives of the government
3. Thýven shall permit the training and funding of the armed forces of Flousech through the procurement of bonds and loans of monetary and technical value.
4. The government of Thýven shall re-establish embassy and permit the establishment of embassy by the Second Republic.
5. The National Gold Reserve shall be granted limited annual access to the Second Republic and its government, amounting to an annual transaction amounting to 1.4% of gold therein reciprocated by trade from the Second Republic. Continued Elbert reading from a copy of the declaration.[/quote]

Muller reads over the terms, he recalls that they where already presented to them in the recogincition agreement.

"I believe these I find very agreeable, although I would like you to elaborate on the gold portion. I might need to request presence of the Secretariat of Finances and Banking so he can inform the Staatsrot depending on what exactly that means. As for the embassy, would you like us to simply return the embassy building you had before, or would you like to build a new one?"

He reads the agreement again, his eyes hovering closely over the second line.

"On second thought, if it isn't to a much of a disruption, I will have him join us when we get to the trade negotiatons."
